Specifically, we need:
- A one-page signed continuity note (company letterhead) stating that control coverage and material changes have been continuously monitored since 2026-07-01 to the present.
- A list of the evidence artifacts you can provide (redacted where needed): change control log summary, KMS key rotation summary, most recent vulnerability scan / remediation status, and any control exceptions since the report period.
- Confirmation whether the note can be signed by your CISO or if you require legal sign-off.

Our timeline is tight: procurement would like the note by EOD 2026-09-07 to keep contracting on schedule. Can you confirm whether you can provide the continuity statement and what artifacts you will include?

If helpful, we can accept a DocuSign-signed PDF.

Best,
